question: What happened when people with ordinary memories practised the memory-palace technique for six weeks?
answer: Their recall more than doubled, and their brains began to resemble the champions'. After 30 minutes a day of placing items along imagined routes, they recalled more than twice as many words from 72-word lists, and resting brain scans shifted towards the connectivity of top memory athletes. Most of the gain held four months later.
move: A rare ability may be an ordinary one trained for longer.
ask: What ability do I call a gift that others might just have trained for longer?
reference: Dresler, Shirer, Konrad, Müller, Wagner, Fernández, Czisch & Greicius, Mnemonic training reshapes brain networks to support superior memory, Neuron, 2017
